I'm so sorry that your Canvas Tote from order TR-4526 never arrived — looking at the tracking, the carrier has marked it as lost in transit. 

Because of that, we handle this as a lost-parcel claim. I've passed your details to a colleague who will sort out a free replacement or a full refund for you, whichever you prefer. Your reference number is **ESC-TR-4526-05120000**, and someone will be in touch during support hours (9 AM to 9 PM IST, seven days a week).
